description: Gate an active goal on its anchor and re-state the sections it may change, restore its frozen spec and carried state after a session or compaction boundary, and record a failed delegation via PostToolUseFailure so a degraded round cannot read as a clean one. Silent in any project without a .goals/active marker. This file is auto-discovered by Claude Code and zCode alike, so it carries only the events both hosts document: zCode has no PreCompact at all (that lives in hooks/claude.json and hooks/codex.json), and Codex, whose manifest replaces discovery with its own file, does not document PostToolUseFailure.

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_stop.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P" ${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT:+--host zcode}; else exec python "$P" ${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT:+--host zcode}; fi

P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_session_start.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi

P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_tool_failure.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi
